rules.statement: Goals enum: hypertrophy, strength, general_fitness (health + some of each), fat_loss (hypertrophy-style training in deficit), endurance_support (RT while cardio is the priority).

Exercise classes for increments/RIR: lower_barbell (squat, deadlift, RDL, hip thrust bar), upper_barbell (bench, OHP, row), dumbbell, machine (pin/plate loaded), cable, bodyweight (pull-up, dip, push-up), isolation (any single-joint regardless of implement; if a movement is single-joint, isolation rules override implement rules for RIR, increments use the implement rule).
Weight-class or event cuts: out of scope for the planner; refer to a sports dietitian (POL-02).
rules.note: policy statement, not an evidence claim

rules.statement: Exercise selection score per slot: pattern preference 0.35, coverage of muscle deficits 0.25, continuity 0.15, user preference 0.10, load-type preference 0.10, difficulty fit 0.05, minus repeat/variety/mild-limitation/no-rack penalties; ties broken by knowledge order (batch, id).

Substitution score: pattern 0.35, muscle-vector cosine 0.35, load fit 0.15, continuity 0.10, difficulty 0.05, plus a bonus for the author's ranked substitutions and a penalty for a different rep profile.
After the greedy set allocation, sets move from muscles above target (surplus >= 2) to muscles below target (deficit >= 1) at equal or lower time cost, only inside the slot's pattern list.
Tier-1 muscles get the VOL-04 band; tier-2 get round(0.6 x band) with floor VOL-01; tier-3 have no target and an advisory direct cap of 6.
Time concession level 1: trim the warm-up (WU-05); skipped when WU-05 already applies.
Time concession level 2: drop isolation sets for muscles that already have >= VOL-01 fractional sets from compounds this week.
Time concession level 3: antagonist / non-competing supersets for isolation and accessory slots (REST-03).
Time concession level 4: rest cut on machine/isolation work to 60 s; main lifts never below 120 s (REST-04).
Time concession level 5: one exercise per pattern.
Time concession level 6: two sets per exercise (never fewer than 1 on the two priority lifts).
Time concession level 7: move the lowest-priority pattern's slot to another open session this week (ledger carryover).

When the prescribed load exceeds what the gym can load (e.g. dumbbells max_kg), keep the load at the maximum and extend the rep band by +2 with RIR -1, or offer the top substitution; the state's working load is not lowered.
RP volume landmarks are direct-count soft caps: once direct sets reach the RP MRV lower bound, further allocation gain for that muscle is halved (novice/intermediate); never a stop condition.
Load increments follow the R4 §5.4 table per load type; gym parameters (plate, rack, stack steps) override the defaults.
An exercise flagged requires_spotter_or_safeties whose satisfied equipment option lacks rack_or_spotter is prescribed with an RIR floor of 2 and a safety note.
The stacked RIR target (profile + week offset + readiness/deload modifiers) is clamped to at most 4 (DEF-04 working-set definition).
A prescribed load is rounded to what the gym can load (bar + plate pairs, dumbbell rack, stack step); a rounding error above 5 % is shown as a modifier.
A user or coach override replaced the planner's choice.
